entry_contract.selected_parent_rows: exact byte-hashed selected_parents.jsonl from the frozen score-channel SHA-256 parent lottery

primary.pair_probability: sigmoid(margin_left_minus_right); the fitted intercept is excluded exactly as in prediction escrow
aggregation_order: average informative pair credits within each selected parent
average selected-parent metrics within each task
average the three frozen selection seeds within each task
average task metrics with equal task weight
primary.task_inclusion: every task with at least one raw-nontied contributing selected parent enters with equal task weight; tasks with one contributing parent remain included and their counts are reported
primary.task_minimum_role: minimum analyzability and breadth floor, not a power guarantee
primary.paired_effect: broad minus concentrated task-macro parent-macro pair accuracy

inference.selection_seed_role: nuisance robustness choices, not independent experimental replications or effective sample-size units
inference.leave_one_task_out: recompute the equal-task-weight mean effect after dropping each task
inference.floating_output: finite IEEE-754 binary64 encoded by canonical JSON

claim_boundary.allowed_only_if_positive: At fixed per-task pair budgets, on a temporally later identity-closed MLE-agent cohort, the predeclared broad-support curation rule outperforms the predeclared concentrated-support rule for this fixed cheap critic on official-five-decimal raw-grade sibling ranking accuracy.

stop_rules: Validate the complete prediction escrow and its artifact hashes before opening any label vault.
Fail closed on any cohort, selected-parent, prediction-pair, vault, raw-grid, or schema mismatch.
If any raw support gate fails, write support counts and status only; do not compute or characterize the primary effect.
Do not change the truth, population, gates, aggregation, bootstrap, effect floor, or claim after any future truth is read.
Normalized truth, log loss, random arm, subgroup, alternate threshold, or alternate aggregation cannot rescue the primary.
